style.style: 16-bit pixel art, top-down three-quarter view, readable shapes, 1px dark outline, soft light from the upper left, gentle greens
rules: No text or logos inside sprites.
Make each character once, then animate that same character. Never remake it for each animation.

ui.prompt: the title 'The Garden Gate' as a logo with leaves
a dark panel with a thin golden edge
